annotations.title: Stop a strategy on a paper box

description: Stop one strategy on a Hyperliquid paper box: its orders are cancelled and its position is closed at the book, unless close_position is false. The answer says stopping until the close fills, then list_box_strategies shows stopped. Needs only the box URL.

box.description: The paper box: its base_url from create_ironbox, or the ibxs_ secret

close_position.description: false leaves its position open on the box; default true

name: stop_box_strategy

notice.description: A note from the API: how a market name was read, why data starts later than asked, or a next step such as a free key

strategy.description: One strategy on a paper box

pnl_usd.description: Net result: realized plus unrealized plus funding minus fees

position.description: Its share of the box's position, signed

stop_reason.description: max_loss, take_profit, liquidated, order_rejected, stopped_by_user, box_reset or box_deleted; null while running

title: Stop a strategy on a paper box
